title: Hardening checklist class for in-band separators in parsed untrusted text
body:
Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md gains an `in-band-separator` class: code that splits untrusted text (commit messages, logs, API fields) on separator bytes uses a framing the data cannot contain (one record per call, NUL with -z, or length-prefixed), each with a fixture that embeds the separator in the data. In #228 review 1 blocked on `git log --format` records split on \x1d/\x1e/\x1f: a Ticket trailer containing \x1d hid a foreign suffix; the fix parsed one commit per `git interpret-trailers` call.
Proof: test/rules asserts the checklist lists in-band-separator, and krn brief check refuses a brief whose Hardening section misses it.
